notes.title: Demo Update
notes.notes: [h1]Royal’s Gambit – Patch Notes v0.5.2[/h1][p]This is a major update packed with long-awaited features, reward reworks, and important fixes. Let’s dive into what’s new!  [/p][h2]📝 NEW FEATURES[/h2][h3]• Tooltips Added[/h3][p]Cards now display tooltips with helpful information to improve decision-making during gameplay:  [b]Number Cards / Rewards[/b] – Show what effect the card will have when played (damage, combo effects, point gains, etc.).  [b]Royal Cards[/b] – Display potential point values based on how the card is defeated (exact vs. overkill).  More tooltip types are planned for future updates, including explanations for chapter mechanics and game modes.  [/p][h3]• Deck View[/h3][p]On the reward screen, you can now view your current deck by clicking the deck or pressing the Right Stick on your controller. No more guessing or trying to remember your build—track your journey with ease.  [/p][h3]• Reward Shaders[/h3][p]Reward cards now feature distinct shader effects for added visual flair. This helps differentiate new card types and adds style to your choices.  [/p][h3]• New Settings Options[/h3][p]We’ve expanded the options menu with several highly requested features:  [b]Sound Effects Volume[/b] – Adjust SFX volume independently.  [b]Toggle Damage Display[/b] – Show or hide the total damage value for added challenge. Great for educational use—encouraging mental math!  [b]Music Playlist Mode[/b] – Instead of looping one song per stage, playlist mode cycles through the chapter’s full soundtrack. (Note: not available in Survival Mode due to current music handling.)  [/p][h2]🎁 REWARDS OVERHAUL[/h2][p]This update brings three brand-new reward types, adding 108 new cards total. Here’s what’s new:  [/p][list][*][p][b]Point Cards[/b] Earn points equal to the card’s number when played—amplified by your current combo. For example, a 9 Point Card played at a 3x combo deals 9 damage and earns 27 points.  [/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][b]Number Combo Cards[/b] Instantly boost your combo by the value of the card. These are perfect for recovering from a drop or stacking big bonuses.  [b]Wild Cards[/b] Playable against any Royal suit. Simple. Versatile. Deadly. [/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][b]Updated: X2 / X3 Cards → Point Multiplier Cards[/b] Damage multiplier cards have been reworked. Instead of boosting raw damage (which rarely aligned with the exact-kill system), these now multiply the points earned from a kill:  Use a [b]x2[/b] or [b]x3 card[/b] on a killing blow to multiply the total score after combo and exact kill bonuses are calculated. This makes them a powerful tool for high-score strategies.  [/p][/*][/list][p]Overall, these new and reworked rewards provide more meaningful choices and better synergy with different game modes.  [/p][h2]🐛 BUG FIXES[/h2][p] [/p][h3]General Fixes:[/h3][list][*][p] Fixed a bug where the game would end with a "no moves" message even after defeating the objective Royal. [/p][/*][*][p] Fixed false-positive 'no moves remaining' detection logic. [/p][/*][*][p] Score formatting added to High Score display on the main menu. [/p][/*][*][p] Fixed an issue where the stage timer would shrink while score points were floating. [/p][/*][*][p] Fixed main menu score display not updating when switching chapters or game modes. [/p][/*][*][p] Fixed a controller navigation bug on the main menu that caused erratic highlight behavior. [/p][/*][*][p] Fixed an issue where multiple cards would discard unintentionally when using a controller. [/p][/*][*][p] Players can no longer play cards after the stage-ending card has been destroyed. [/p][/*][*][p] Fixed a bug allowing card selection while paused using the controller’s A button. [/p][/*][*][p] You can now skip the victory/credits screen using Start or B on the controller. [/p][/*][/list][p] This is one of our most substantial updates yet—improving usability, strategy, and presentation across the board. Thank you for playing and keep sending your feedback![/p]

notes.title: The future of Royal's Gambit!
notes.notes:
[p][b]🎉 Greetings from 96 Games Studio! 🎉[/b][/p][p]With Steam Next Fest now underway, we wanted to take a moment to sincerely thank everyone who has downloaded the [b]Royal’s Gambit[/b] demo, reached out with questions, and offered feedback. Your support means the world to us. As our first title, we’re pouring our hearts into this game—and your feedback is already helping shape its future.[/p][p]Let’s take a look at what’s coming next![/p][hr][/hr][h3]🔨 [b]Now in Development: Version 0.5.0[/b][/h3][p]We're currently hard at work on [b]Royal’s Gambit v0.5.0[/b], a major content update packed with new features and improvements. Here’s a sneak peek at what’s already working in the beta:[/p][list][*][p][b]New Reward Card Types[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Music Playlist Setting[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Show Damage Toggle[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Tooltips Added[/b][/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h3]🃏 [b]New Reward Card Types[/b][/h3][p]We’ve added three exciting new card types to the reward pool! These are number cards with bonus effects—play them not only to damage Royals, but also to boost your score or increase your combo. You’ll also find [b]wild cards[/b] that can be used against any Royal. This update introduces [b]108 new cards[/b] to discover in your reward selections![/p][hr][/hr][h3]🎵 [b]Music Playlist Mode[/b][/h3][p]You asked, and we listened! Some of you wanted to enjoy the music without stage-based transitions—so we’re introducing [b]Playlist Mode[/b]. Toggle it in the settings menu to enjoy a continuous music experience as you battle through the game. (Note: this mode isn’t compatible with Survival Mode just yet, but we’re exploring ways to bring it there too.)[/p][hr][/hr][h3]➕ [b]Show Damage Toggle[/b][/h3][p]Several players—and even a few teachers—asked for a way to hide the card damage display to encourage mental math. You’ll now find a toggle in the settings menu that turns damage values on or off, making the game more educational or challenging depending on how you want to play.[/p][hr][/hr][h3]💬 [b]Tooltips[/b][/h3][p]New to the game? No worries! Cards in your hand now display [b]tooltips[/b] to help you understand their effects at a glance. We’ll be expanding this system to include Royals and other gameplay mechanics in future chapters.[/p][hr][/hr][h3]🔮 What’s Next?[/h3][p]We’re aiming to add another [b]20 levels[/b] across the remaining [b]planned 5 chapters[/b] for the game’s full release. We’re also in the early stages of implementing [b]Steam achievements[/b] and [b]trading cards[/b].[/p][p]But our plans don’t stop at launch! Inspired by the PC games of the ‘90s, we want to keep supporting [b]Royal’s Gambit[/b] post-launch with [b]new (free!) content[/b]—potentially including new chapters, game modes, card skins, music, and maybe even [b]user-created content[/b] in the future.[/p][hr][/hr][h3]💌 Stay Connected[/h3][p]Whether you love the game or think we’re totally off track, we want to hear from you. Your feedback helps make [b]Royal’s Gambit[/b] better. Join us on [b]Discord[/b], follow us on social media, or shoot us an email—we’re always listening.[/p][p]Thank you again for playing! And if you haven’t yet, we hope this announcement piques your interest.[/p][p]—[/p][p]🧙‍♂️ [b]Jimmay & TacoMonkeyGod[/b]
[i]96 Games Studio[/i][/p][hr][/hr][p][b]P.S.[/b] If you’ve read this far—awesome! After Next Fest wraps up, we’ll be opening [b]testing applications[/b] on Steam. The full release date will depend on your feedback and how fast the two of us can implement all the features we’ve planned. So if you’d like to help shape the future of [b]Royal’s Gambit[/b], keep an eye out for the tester application announcement![/p]

notes.title: Royal's Gambit Shines on Steam Deck!
notes.notes:
Hey everyone,

Great news for our portable players! We wanted to share that Royal's Gambit is performing beautifully on the Steam Deck. The game already features full Xbox controller support, and our internal tests (though conducted by our cozy two-person team with a single, trusty Steam Deck!) show a smooth and seamless experience. We haven't encountered any issues specific to the device.

We're eager to hear about your adventures with Royal's Gambit on the Steam Deck! Your feedback is invaluable to us. Please share your experiences and any other thoughts in the Steam Community Hub, on our Facebook page, or by dropping us an email at contact@96gamesstudio.com.

Happy gaming on the go!

[list]
[*] TacoMonkeyGod, Lead Developer
[/list]
